explain:cec72ff7e5fbdf4c: Maya has the Product design and Frontend you listed as missing, and you have the Backend and ML she's been stuck without for two years of half-finished tools. You both want the same thing badly enough to have written it down separately: software that gets bedroom producers to actually finish a song.

ideas:cec72ff7e5fbdf4c.name: Loop Swap
ideas:cec72ff7e5fbdf4c.one_liner: Post an 8-bar loop, get it back finished by a stranger in 48 hours.
